info.description: REST API for TeslaMate data, including V1 resources and V2 objective analytics.
info.title: TeslaMateApi

get.description: Returns cars registered in TeslaMate. Omit CarID to list all cars; include CarID for a single car.
get.summary: List TeslaMate cars or get one car

get.description: Returns cars registered in TeslaMate. Omit CarID to list all cars; include CarID for a single car.
get.summary: List TeslaMate cars or get one car
Get battery health for one car
List charging sessions for one car
Get active charging session if any
Get one charging session by ID

get.description: GET returns enabled_commands. POST proxies to Tesla Owner API; response body follows Tesla API JSON. Also registered as POST /v1/cars/{CarID}/wake_up.
get.summary: Tesla vehicle commands (when ENABLE_COMMANDS is true)

post.description: GET returns enabled_commands. POST proxies to Tesla Owner API; response body follows Tesla API JSON. Also registered as POST /v1/cars/{CarID}/wake_up.
post.summary: Tesla vehicle commands (when ENABLE_COMMANDS is true)

get.description: GET returns enabled_commands. POST proxies to Tesla Owner API; response body follows Tesla API JSON. Also registered as POST /v1/cars/{CarID}/wake_up.
get.summary: Tesla vehicle commands (when ENABLE_COMMANDS is true)

get.description: GET returns enabled_commands list; PUT forwards to TeslaMate logging API.
get.summary: TeslaMate logging commands (when ENABLE_COMMANDS is true)

put.description: GET returns enabled_commands list; PUT forwards to TeslaMate logging API.
put.summary: TeslaMate logging commands (when ENABLE_COMMANDS is true)

get.description: Requires MQTT; returns cached telemetry when available.

get.summary: List firmware updates for one car

post.description: GET returns enabled_commands. POST proxies to Tesla Owner API; response body follows Tesla API JSON. Also registered as POST /v1/cars/{CarID}/wake_up.
post.summary: Tesla vehicle commands (when ENABLE_COMMANDS is true)

get.description: Returns the V2 analytics API version, scope, and currently advertised feature groups.
Returns objective latest battery range samples, estimated full-range values, baseline range, and estimated range degradation. These estimates are not official state of health.
Returns battery_level sample counts grouped into 10 percent buckets from 0-10 through 90-100.
Returns estimated full rated and ideal range grouped by day, week, month, or year for trend charts.
Returns objective charging statistics and optional previous-period comparison for one car.
Returns objective charging cost, energy, and distance-normalized cost metrics.
Returns objective charging metrics grouped by geofence or address.
Returns charging metrics grouped by day, week, month, or year for charting.
Returns objective charging metrics grouped by AC, DC, Tesla Supercharger, or unknown type.
get.summary: V2 charging analytics by charger type

get.description: Returns objective charging-cost analytics. Current data scope includes charging_cost only and excludes insurance, maintenance, parking, depreciation, tire, and repair costs.
Returns objective driving statistics and optional previous-period comparison for one car.
Returns drive-count, distance, and duration distribution for a selected factual dimension.
Returns objective top drives or top driving days by selected ranking type.
Returns driving metrics grouped by day, week, month, or year for charting.
Returns objective drive efficiency metrics, including estimated energy consumption, average/best/worst consumption, average temperature, and average speed.
Returns factual efficiency metrics grouped by one selected dimension. Bucketed results do not imply causation.
Returns cumulative lifetime statistics for a car from the first recorded event up to as_of (defaults to now). Use as_of for historical snapshots.

parameters.description: Cutoff datetime in RFC3339 format. Defaults to now.
parameters.name: as_of

get.description: Returns objective usage metrics grouped by geofence or address, including drive starts, drive ends, charging, inferred parking, and estimated vampire drain.
Returns objective parked duration, state duration, inferred parking sessions, and estimated parking drain for one car.
Returns inferred parking sessions and parked duration grouped by geofence or address.
Returns online, asleep, offline, and unknown state durations, shares, and transition counts.
Returns objective driving, charging, parking, battery, update, and charging-cost summary metrics for one car in a selected period.
Returns OTA update history statistics for a car in the selected period.

parameters.description: Comparison mode (accepted for meta consistency; response has no comparison block)
parameters.name: compare

get.description: Returns per-day aggregated statistics for calendar/heatmap views. All dates in the requested range are returned, with zeros for days without data.
Returns factual, evidence-backed insights based on period comparison. No subjective evaluations.
Returns a structured period report combining multiple analytics modules. Only sections with data are included.
Returns a cursor-paginated unified chronological timeline of drive, charging, and update events.

parameters.description: Return events before this RFC3339 timestamp (cursor, DESC order)
parameters.name: before

parameters.description: Return events after this RFC3339 timestamp (cursor, ASC order)
parameters.name: after

comparison.description: Comparison keys: summary metric field names (e.g. latest_rated_range_km).
Comparison keys: summary metric field names (e.g. energy_added_kwh, session_count).
Comparison keys: summary metric field names (e.g. distance_km, drive_count).
Comparison keys: summary metric field names (e.g. parked_duration_min).
Comparison keys: driving/charging/parking/battery/updates/vehicle/cost field paths; values are current vs previous period.
